story.title: Let's make maps
paragraphs_en: Meena and Rahul were playing in the kitchen, it was raining so they were at home. They were in the kitchen enjoying, when thier mother shouted saying" meena rahul go in your room ",Meena and Rahul ran and left the kitchen all dirty. When thier mother reached there she almost fainted by seeing the mess.

Meena and Rahul were bored. Suddenly Rahul had a idea'' lets make a map'' he said,Meena replied'' we need a globe'',Rahul said'' do we have any'' they went in thier secret closet there said Meena. Ok lets start they grabbed all thier supplies and got to work.

While looking at the globe Rahul spined the globe and it came out and broke ,they were worried and said "now how to write the coutries we do not know any" Meena said worried.' Yes Meena', said Rahul.What shall we do lets find a new globe Rahul suggested Meena agreed and of they went.

Meena and Rahul started running jumping and looking for a globe . They looked up down under thier parents bed even in the kitchen( thier favourite place to play) while running around the house they bumped into thier parents BAM.

They were very scared the saw the angry eyes of thier parents just like they found out Rahul and Meena did something wrong .They started scratching thier hair confused.They ran shouting and locked thier rooms gate.

They were confused and angry .Then Meena said "i guess we can not make a map afterall" and decided to go and confess it out to thier parents . So Meena and Rahul started walking slowly towards thier parents with a shy look. They were confused and sad.

When they reached they said ''ma pa we are sorry that we broke the globe we were using it to make something and it broke".Thier parents asked what were you trying to make? Rahul and Meena said together ''ma pa we were trying to make a map ". So then they smiled we will.

Meena and Rahul were so happy that they started wearing capes and acted like superkids. Thier mother said "come on lets make a map". When the parents entered Meena and Rahul's room they almost fainted by seeing thE mess. Meena said" sorry ma Pa".

Meena and Rahul said" before we start we have to get ready we are just coming" they came and they started.Thier mum asked them ''do you know who are map makers called, Meena and Rahul said'' no ma." they are called cartographers"."oh" Meena and Rahul said curiously.

They said are we cartographers to ? ma nodded. So we shall get ready Meena said and Rahul nodded and of they went they cut thier hair and brushed it to. they came back and said ready thier mother and father laughed and thier father said ''my crazy haired cartographers .

By the time the rain had stopped and Rahul and Meena marched out of the house ready to play horay they said as the marched and then they shouted''' yay our map is finished ''and walked to a tree totally ready to climb. Rahul and Meena marched right till there.

They climbed up the tree and had a idea that next time instead of a map we will roam the whole world and yes we will stop fora small vacation.Then they fell asleep still dreaming about the world..............
